title: Holonomy-robust Mirror code transport
hypothesis: On a frozen sequence of chart changes, transported Mirror codes reduce same-function code drift by >=25% median versus direct code carryover and native Procrustes, without worsening target function loss by >0.01 nats/token or raising serialized inference state >10%.
physical_object: one pretrained attention model and shared Mirror basis transported between equivalent parameter charts
mirror_coordinate: chart-specific m corrected by a cheap transport address
logical_multiplicity: stable reusable task m across equivalent optimization/gauge histories
closest_controls: no transport / orthogonal Procrustes / direct native re-fit / gauge-aware optimizer

requirements.native: Implement standard code re-fitting or Procrustes alignment between weight-basis charts using a fixed calibration split and equal adaptation steps.
requirements.insertion: At each optimizer/chart transition, calculate a source-only transport matrix for the small m code or its tangent basis. Keep shared weights and code function fixed; do not declare the resulting gauge difference a new function.
requirements.method: First use a closed exact change-of-basis loop G1,G2,G2^{-1},G1^{-1} and verify final parameter product is identity; this is a gauge-safety unit test, NOT a holonomy demonstration. Then use a small rectangular horizontal parameter-update loop and estimate connection-based transport plus a separate gauge-normalization step. Log path dependence and whether the induced code correction preserves predictions; report connection definition and discretization error.
requirements.fixture: Two-head d=16 attention, 6 source chart trajectories and 4 unseen loop trajectories of 4 or 8 small update segments, lengths fixed before audit. Use one frozen teacher objective with separate probe inputs and held-out examples.
requirements.hardware: Stage 1 CPU float64 NumPy/PyTorch; no pretrained large language model required. Stage 2 CUDA only for a separately approved small-transformer transfer test.

development.allowed: select code dimension, LR, stop condition only

resources.compute: training examples and updates, FLOPs or MACs, CPU/GPU P50/P95 with batch/dtype/hardware
resources.quality: Relative code drift after cycle, maximum function/logit discrepancy, NLL retention, fit steps to restore code, code/transport bytes, matrix conditioning and update-loop area.

gates.PASS: At least 4/5 fresh seeds show >=25% lower code drift than best native alignment, no excess NLL >0.01, and all persistent transport bytes <=1.10 best control; any claimed m reuse also meets equal-input prediction check.
gates.FAIL: Correct exact closed gauge loop alone appears to create new function; transport loses accuracy or uses more bytes without sample-efficiency gain; Procrustes alone matches.
gates.UNCERTAIN: Missing strong control, uncertain precision, insufficient heldout data, unmeasured runtime or CI overlap

alternative: Nontrivial holonomy lives in coordinate transport, not newly distinguishable functions; computation may overwhelm storage savings.
uncertainty: Discrete connection approximation, floating point, ill-conditioned charts, path length and loop area; estimate errors across 5 seeds and two step-size grids.
stopping: Stop after 3 dev seeds then 5 fresh worlds; if cheap mechanism fails predeclared gate, record negative and do not tune fresh. Hardware unavailable => BLOCKED (not PASS).
prior_art_delta: Test whether cheap m transport suppresses spurious gauge drift during repeated reuse, beyond static gauge audits; holonomy itself is not new functional multiplicity.
limitations: Does not claim holonomy itself represents a new task or that gauge loops guarantee useful memory savings.

uncertainty_model.observable: Quality Q in its declared units (nat/token or dimensionless error), task/seed paired samples
uncertainty_model.combined_standard: u_c=sqrt(u_seed^2+u_eval^2+u_num^2) for independent components; include covariance otherwise
uncertainty_model.expanded: U=k_cov*u_c; only indicative with 5 worlds, bootstrap interval primary
uncertainty_model.storage: actual byte count is exact for fixed serialization
uncertainty_model.sequential_stop: perform all five frozen fresh worlds, do not early-stop for favorable result or tune on audit data
